entities.name: Nimiroti Wola
entities.description: Zimone Wola's grandmother and a famous mage and former Strixhaven professor who erased her own memory to protect her secrets from the Oriq.

entities.name: Dean Imbraham
entities.description: Remembers Nimiroti as his best student and colleague.

entities.name: Codie
entities.description: The Codex Vocifera, which Zimone found through a note from Nimiroti.

entities.name: Oriq
entities.description: Group with malevolent intentions from whom Nimiroti kept the Vorzani Conjecture.

entities.name: Strixhaven
entities.description: The university where Nimiroti was a professor.

entities.name: Vorzani Conjecture
entities.description: Secret that Nimiroti kept from the Oriq.

entities.name: Sanctuary of the Lost
entities.description: Place for those affected by magic where Nimiroti was found.
